description: Change a webhook's address, events, description or include_text, or turn it off or on (active). Turning it on again clears its failure count. Owners and admins only.

events.description: Event types to send: post.approved, post.scheduled, post.published, post.failed, edit.ready_for_review, edit.failed, comment.received, message.received, link.signup, account.needs_reconnect.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

url.description: Where Chockstone sends the call: a public https address (an n8n Webhook node's Production URL, a Make or Zapier catch hook). No redirects are followed.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: webhook_update
title: Change a webhook
